name: OccupancyUtilisationHeatmap
tagline: See when every floor and zone is used – and right-size it with evidence.
description: Complete workplace utilisation app for Power Apps and Power Pages: floor/zone × day/hour heatmap with average and peak, utilisation bands, suggested capacity from peak demand and a target utilisation, seats to release and annual saving, and a right-sizing plan workflow from suggestion to implementation.
features: Average vs peak utilisation heatmap by zone, floor, building, type or department
Day × hour, hour-of-day and day-of-week columns
Underused / right-sized / crowded bands with configurable thresholds
Suggested capacity = peak ÷ target peak, with seat change and annual saving
Plan workflow: suggested → under review → approved → implemented / dismissed with rules
Bulk status, owner assignment, CSV export, undo
Teal, blue or traffic-light colour scales
Keyboard-navigable ARIA grid, phone bottom bar
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
